ABOUT .04

WHAT IS
.04?

Point Oh Four is a stamp of approval — a cultural programming and experiential agency operating at the intersection of technology, wellness, and creativity.

Our mission: define culture through influential experiences — connecting visionary brands, iconic venues, and emerging creative talent, transforming spaces into immersive showcases of innovation, wellness, and artistic expression.

Creating perfectly calibrated moments... memorable without excess.

EXPERIENCE DESIGN

THREE
PILLARS

01 MIND

Technology

Innovation, future thinking, and digital culture — programming that puts ideas at the center of the room.

02 BODY

Wellness

Health, movement, and performance as culture. We build activations that resonate in the body, not just the mind.

03 SOUL

Creativity

Art, music, fashion, and expression — the connective tissue between community and experience.
